# Monotonic relative ID generator behaviour. "reset" starts a new generator.
#   next <tag> <now_ms> <random_hex> <expected>
# random_hex: the 7 bytes the random source returns if the call draws randomness,
#             or "-" if the call must not draw any.
# expected:   the ID text, or "error" (the call fails and the generator is unchanged).
reset
